selectors.literal_quote: The Guidelines also address the possibility to establish a certification mechanism to demonstrate compliance with Article 25 in Chapter four, as well as how the Article may be enforced by supervisory authorities in Chapter five. Finally, the Guidelines provide stakeholders with recommendations on how to successfully implement DPbDD.
